item.title: Open call: DSAC Mzansi Golden Economy grant funding
item.description: The National Department of Sport, Arts and Culture (DSAC) has opened applications for grant funding under the Mzansi Golden Economy (MGE) programme, inviting submissions from organisations operating in the arts, culture and heritage sectors. Funding will support projects scheduled for implementation between May 2026 and February 2027. item.title: Zim Hip Hop Awards 2025: All the winners
item.description: The Zim Hip Hop Awards were held at Zimbali Gardens in Harare, Zimbabwe on 13 December, with Bling 4 emerging as one of the most recognised rappers in the country. Bling 4 won Best Male and contributing to Song of the Year for ‘Boyz Rangu’, a collaboration with Runna Rulez. Runna Rulez also secured the People’s Choice Award, reflecting strong audience support. item.title: Condolences pour in after killing of SA radio presenter DJ Warras
item.description: Condolences have continued to pour in following the killing of South African radio and club DJ Warrick Stock, popularly known as DJ Warras, who was shot dead in Johannesburg’s central business district on 16 December. His death comes amid heightened concern after a recent court case linked to South Africa’s law enforcement scandal included claims by the State that a criminal network has been targeting DJs in the province. item.title: AFROSON1C X returns to Accra with The Cavemen headlining 2026 edition
item.description: West Africa’s premier music, innovation, and cultural showcase, AFROSON1C X (AFX), is set to return to Accra on 10 January 2026 at Treehouse Restaurant, Nyaniba. The festival follows international appearances at SXSW London and the Reeperbahn Festival in 2025, with organisers aiming to connect the global creative ecosystem to the next generation of West African talent. item.title: MASO Music Awards 2025 in Malawi: All the winners
item.description: The 2025 MASO Music Awards were held at the Bingu International Conference Centre Auditorium on 13 December under the theme Creating Wealth Through Exporting Arts. The ceremony celebrated achievements across music, film, fashion, visual arts, and media, highlighting Malawi’s growing creative industry. item.title: Hendrikje Crebolder appointed interim director of Prince Claus Fund
item.description: The Prince Claus Fund has announced the appointment of Hendrikje Crebolder as its interim director, effective 1 January 2026. Crebolder, who currently serves as a Supervisory Board member at the Fund, will assume leadership as the organisation approaches its 30th anniversary. Crebolder is a prominent cultural leader and former lawyer, recognised for her role as the first female executive board member of the Rijksmuseum, where she contributed significantly to expanding its international profile.

item.title: Mozambique: Assa Matusse shares new single TEKA NDZINGU
item.description: Mozambican singer and songwriter Assa Matusse has released a new single titled ‘TEKA NDZINGU’, an Afropop track exploring themes of resilience, emotional struggle and recovery. Written and performed by Matusse, ‘TEKA NDZINGU’ draws inspiration from a cultural encounter during her time in South Africa. item.title: Beatchain, AFROSON1C X launch WAVVI to support West African artists
item.description: Beatchain, the AI-driven A&R, artist, and label services platform, has partnered with AFROSON1C X (AFX) to launch WAVVI, a new platform designed to support artist discovery and services across West Africa. The initiative marks Beatchain’s first expansion into the Sub-Saharan African market following its entry into India last year. item.title: MIAF and Busara Promotions partner to extend Gender@Work into East Africa
item.description: The Music In Africa Foundation (MIAF) and Busara Promotions, organisers of the Sauti za Busara festival, have partnered to expand the Gender@Work training programme for women into East Africa. Launched by MIAF in 2019, Gender@Work is a continental training programme dedicated exclusively to upskilling women working, or aspiring to work, in the music industry.
